figures.shows: The Asset tab with the robot's skeleton of the third-person sample: the Joints section counts 45 joints and lists the first of them set in by depth, the root motion joint Bone in orange
figures.caption: The Joints section of the robot's skeleton. Each row is one joint, set in one step further than its parent, so every parent stands above its children.
figures.alt: The editor's Asset tab for the robot's skeleton. A line gives the joint count and the root motion joint, Bone. Below it, a scrolling list with one bone icon and name per joint, each level set in further. The icon of Bone is orange.
